ground_truth.title: Wendi Weiner - The Writing Guru
ground_truth.main_content:
The #1 expert in helping executives and board members build a personal brand that outshines the competition.

60%+ of business leaders and board members hire an executive resume writer to accelerate career and board opportunities. It’s time to hire a true writing guru with the proven credibility, authority, and trust to get the results you need (and want).

✔ Attorney and Former College Writing Professor representing the most powerful career background within the resume writing industry. Our decade-plus legal career spanned law firm (Am Law 200 to boutique) and corporate environments (AGC for a commercial insurer; senior litigation counsel at a Fortune 200) with C-suite and board reporting. We sat on hiring teams, making us intimately familiar with hiring and recruitment processes. We also taught college and business writing courses for 7+ years.

✔ Multi-Certified Executive and Board Resume Writer with advanced training and a proven acumen in executive and board resume writing, personal branding, LinkedIn profile writing, and career coaching. We stay abreast of cutting-edge resume techniques, emerging job search strategies, and board governance trends. We hold the Nationally Certified Resume Writer (NCRW) certification (the first-ever NCRW and licensed attorney).

✔ 10X+ Award-Winning Career Expert rated as the #1 Resume Expert by Recruiter.com, recipient of the 2025 American Bar Association Award for Service to the Legal Profession in advancing lawyer careers, awarded Best Career Professional by Career Directors International (voted by industry peers), Recommended Executive Resume Writer by Heller Search Group since 2018 (IT executive search firm), Best Executive Resume Writing Service by Balance Careers, and 9 Best Career Coaches Online by Career Sidekick.

✔ Top-Published Writer (100+ Bylined Articles), including features in 75+ major media outlets on personal branding, career advice, executive resume writing, and LinkedIn. W e’ve held multiple contributor columns in Above the Law, CNBC, The Ladders, HuffPost, and Thrive Global. We’ve been hired directly by top companies to write LinkedIn profiles for public-facing executive teams. We’ve also been contracted by Inc. Magazine’s branding division as an established resource for writing branded content.

✔ Resume Industry Leader, Past Board Member, and Sought-After Speaker at national conferences, global seminars, and symposiums for legal, executive recruiter, and board organizations. Elected to serve on the board for the National Resume Writers’ Association for 3 years (President-Elect/Ethics Chair, 2018; Director of Industry, 2016 – 2018), we’ve also lobbied to increase the public image of the resume industry.

✔ 1:1 Commitment to Clients with genuine care for our work product and results. Our testimonials and referrals from past clients, executive search recruiters, and professional associations such as the ACC and NACD are a testament to the expertise we hold and passion we pour into our projects. Unlike most executive resume writing services, we do not outsource any work to a subcontractor, ghostwriter, or “team.”

The Best Executive Resume Writer for Attorneys, Executives, & Board Members

Your job is what you do, but your personal brand is who you are.™ Your resume is the most important document in your career, but a standard resume is no longer enough in the digital age. You need a digital footprint that’s easily discoverable when employers research you and a powerful personal brand that effectively markets your leadership value, skills, credentials, and accolades. Since 85% of resume writing is based on strategy, you need a true writing guru and writing expert with the innovative analysis and gravitas to create your personal brand from an objective standpoint or that 30,000 foot view.

 » » Read our informative article: How to Research & Review Executive Resume Writing Services

We work exclusively and 1:1 (no teams, no subcontractors) with high-profile corporate counsels, equity partners, C-suite executives, and board members at Fortune 500s, start-ups, private equity, and VC-backed companies. We’re one of the few top executive resume writers who maintained a high-caliber executive career prior to entering the resume industry. Here’s why you should choose Wendi Weiner, The Writing Guru as your trusted partner for your resume and career documents:

✔ Our Unique Professional Background Garners More Results: Executives are sophisticated leaders and need an equally sophisticated executive resume writer with stellar academic and professional credentials. As a former litigation and appellate attorney, we’ve been trained to think in a systematic and logical way. We know how to think fast on our feet, synthesize large volumes of information (i.e., 20+ year career histories), and make compelling (and articulate) statements that win over the toughest of audiences. We assist our clients with best practices in job coaching, job search management, and networking strategies. We have hiring experience and know what firms and companies are looking for when hiring a candidate.

If you Google Wendi Weiner, The Writing Guru, you’ll see WHY we’ve been revered as the “best executive resume writer,” “best legal resume writer,” and a “best executive resume writing service.” While the majority of our high-profile clients do not post their reviews publicly, we’ve received a number of detailed reviews across Yelp, Google, and LinkedIn from clients sharing their experience and successful outcomes.

✔ 6 Resume Writing & Career Industry Certifications: With approximately ~40 Nationally Certified Resume Writers (NCRWs) at the time in the country, we’re the only NCRW who’s also a licensed attorney! In addition to being a prestigious NCRW, we hold 5 other resume and career certifications: Nationally Certified Online Profile Expert (NCOPE), Certified Professional Resume Writer (CPRW), Certified Career Transition Coach (CCTC), Credentialed Career Manager (CCM), and a Certified 360Reach Analyst with additional training in personal branding assessments. We continue to attend and speak at annual resume and career industry conferences as a result of our expertise, knowledge, and credibility.

✔ Multi-Dimensional Professional Writer: Resume writing and personal branding are true art forms that few can master. A top resume writer is more than just someone who writes a beautifully worded career document. Our 20+ years of professional writing experience as a college writing professor, legal writer, published writer with bylined articles and columns, and top resume writer has enabled us to imprint our influence with thousands of satisfied professional and executive resume clients, and most importantly – a proven track record of powerful results. We are the most published career expert with hundreds of features and article publications in 75+ major media outlets, including 100+ bylined articles!

Are you a senior-level attorney, executive, or C-suite leader looking to make a challenging lateral move to a top company?

Are you job searching for the first time in more than a decade (or two decades) and feeling behind the times on current resume writing and LinkedIn trends?

Are you a business owner, entrepreneur, or consultant who is struggling to market your personal brand on LinkedIn?

Are you ready to take the leap into improving your career and creating more personal fulfillment?

Are you tired of being passed up for the jobs you really want or tired of not getting traction in your job search?

If you’ve answered “yes” to these questions, we encourage you to book a consultation with Wendi Weiner, The Writing Guru! Gain the competitive edge you need by supercharging your professional and personal brand with the attorney and executive resume writer who has been awarded the BEST in the industry. Investing in a top executive resume writer or top executive resume writing service can give you the biggest return: an interview at the most coveted companies for the most coveted roles.
